metadata.description: Personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins to experiment with.

plugins.name: comms
plugins.description: Communication-style features (response formatting, tone, register). Exactly one style active at a time.

plugins.name: slog
plugins.description: Long-horizon work driven through a living markdown document per feature, instead of chat back-and-forth.

plugins.name: autoland
plugins.description: Commit, push, open a PR, request Copilot review, resolve comments, watch CI, and merge — no human approval requested except on genuinely significant calls.

plugins.name: cleanup
plugins.description: Inventory development leftovers in the current worktree — merged branches, containers, stale processes, scratch files — and delete only what's confirmed.
